title: Dual 2-line to 4-line decoders/demultiplexers

sources.document: TI SN54LS139A/SN54S139/SN74LS139A/SN74S139A datasheet SDLS013A (December 1972, revised March 1988)

functions.text: 1Y0 is low when 1G is low and 1B,1A = 0; high otherwise.
1Y1 is low when 1G is low and 1B,1A = 1; high otherwise.
1Y2 is low when 1G is low and 1B,1A = 2; high otherwise.
1Y3 is low when 1G is low and 1B,1A = 3; high otherwise.
2Y0 is low when 2G is low and 2B,2A = 0; high otherwise.
2Y1 is low when 2G is low and 2B,2A = 1; high otherwise.
2Y2 is low when 2G is low and 2B,2A = 2; high otherwise.
2Y3 is low when 2G is low and 2B,2A = 3; high otherwise.

electrical.notes: SN74LS139A figures (page 3). SN74S139A: IOL 20 mA, IOH -1 mA (page 4).

timing.conditions: VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 2 kohm, CL 15 pF; 2 levels of delay
VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 2 kohm, CL 15 pF; 2 levels of delay
VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 2 kohm, CL 15 pF; 3 levels of delay
VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 2 kohm, CL 15 pF; 3 levels of delay
VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 2 kohm, CL 15 pF; 2 levels of delay
VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 2 kohm, CL 15 pF; 2 levels of delay

unknown: The datasheet does not say which select-to-output paths have 2 and which have 3 levels of delay.
notes: Timing is the SN74LS139A table (page 3). SN74S139A (page 4, RL 280 ohm, CL 15 pF): select 2 levels tPLH 5/7.5, tPHL 6.5/10; 3 levels tPLH 7/12, tPHL 8/12; enable tPLH 5/8, tPHL 6.5/10 ns typ/max. Plain file: the lookup uses it for 74LS139 and 74S139.
